<style>
html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
/* ===== RESET & ROOT ===== */
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
:root{
  --bg:#0a0e1a;--bg2:#0f1424;--bg3:#151b30;
  --card:#131a2e;--card2:#1a2240;
  --cyan:#00f5ff;--violet:#a855f7;--pink:#ec4899;--gold:#fbbf24;
  --text:#e8ecff;--muted:#8b92b8;
  --border:rgba(0,245,255,0.14);
  --glow-c:0 0 24px rgba(0,245,255,0.20),0 12px 32px -16px rgba(0,245,255,0.35);
  --glow-v:0 0 24px rgba(168,85,247,0.20),0 12px 32px -16px rgba(168,85,247,0.35);
  --grad:linear-gradient(135deg,#00f5ff 0%,#a855f7 60%,#ec4899 100%);
  --r:6px;
}
body{background:var(--bg);background-image:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');background-position:center center;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:fixed;color:var(--text);font-family:'DM Sans',-apple-system,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden;}
body::before{content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(4,7,15,.58),rgba(4,7,15,.78));z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;}
@media(max-width:900px){body{background-attachment:scroll;}}

body.light-mode{--bg:#f7f8fc;--bg2:#eef0f8;--bg3:#e3e7f3;--card:#ffffff;--card2:#f1f3fa;--text:#0a0e1a;--muted:#5b6489;--border:rgba(20,40,90,0.14);}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg2)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--grad);border-radius:2px}
a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit;}

/* ===== SCROLL BAR ===== */
#scroll-bar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:0%;height:3px;background:var(--grad);z-index:10000;transition:width .1s linear;}

/* ===== CURSOR ===== */
#cur{position:fixed;width:10px;height:10px;background:var(--cyan);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);mix-blend-mode:difference;}
#cur-o{position:fixed;width:32px;height:32px;border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,0.5);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:9998;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:all .12s ease;}
@media(hover:none){#cur,#cur-o{display:none}}

/* ===== PRELOADER ===== */
#preloader{position:fixed;inset:0;background:var(--bg);z-index:100000;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;}
#preloader .pl-name{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(32px,6vw,54px);font-weight:800;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
#preloader .pl-bar{width:180px;height:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;}
#preloader .pl-fill{height:100%;background:var(--grad);border-radius:3px;animation:plFill 2s ease forwards;}
@keyframes plFill{0%{width:0}100%{width:100%}}
#preloader .pl-sub{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:4px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;}

/* ===== NAV ===== */
#nav{position:fixed;top:0;width:100%;height:68px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 5%;z-index:5000;background:rgba(4,7,15,0.9);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);transition:all .3s;}
#nav.solid{background:rgba(4,7,15,0.92);box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);}
.n-logo{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:22px;font-weight:800;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;cursor:pointer;}
.n-links{display:flex;list-style:none;gap:28px;}
.n-links a{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);transition:color .25s;position:relative;}
.n-links a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-3px;width:0;height:1.5px;background:var(--cyan);transition:width .3s;}
.n-links a:hover{color:var(--cyan);}
.n-links a:hover::after{width:100%;}
.n-cta{background:var(--grad)!important;-webkit-background-clip:unset!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:unset!important;background-clip:unset!important;color:#000!important;padding:7px 18px;border-radius:50px;font-weight:600!important;}
.n-cta::after{display:none!important;}
.n-cta:hover{transform:scale(1.04);box-shadow:var(--glow-c);}
#n-burger{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;cursor:pointer;z-index:5001;}
#n-burger span{display:block;width:22px;height:2px;background:var(--text);border-radius:1px;transition:all .3s;}
#mobile-nav{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(4,7,15,0.97);z-index:4999;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:28px;}
#mobile-nav.active{display:flex;}
#mobile-nav a{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:26px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);transition:color .2s;}
#mobile-nav a:hover{color:var(--cyan);}
#m-close{position:absolute;top:22px;right:5%;font-size:26px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted);}

/* ===== HERO ===== */
#hero{position:relative;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:110px 5% 70px;overflow:hidden;background:transparent;}
#ptc{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;opacity:.55;}
.h-glow{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 60% at 65% 45%,rgba(124,58,237,0.18) 0%,transparent 70%),radial-gradient(ellipse 45% 55% at 20% 80%,rgba(0,245,255,0.12) 0%,transparent 60%);pointer-events:none;z-index:0;}
.h-wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;gap:48px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.h-left{flex:1 1 480px;min-width:0;max-width:620px;text-align:left;animation:heroFadeUp 1.05s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.3,1) both;}
.h-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(0,245,255,0.07);border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,0.18);padding:5px 14px;border-radius:50px;font-size:12px;color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:22px;}
.h-badge-dot{width:7px;height:7px;background:var(--cyan);border-radius:50%;animation:blink-dot 1.4s infinite;}
@keyframes blink-dot{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.4;transform:scale(1.5)}}
.h-title{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(26px,6.2vw,56px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:14px;overflow-wrap:break-word;word-break:break-word;}
.h-grad{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
.h-typed-wrap{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(15px,2.2vw,20px);color:var(--cyan);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:16px;min-height:28px;}
.h-typed-wrap .cursor{animation:curs .9s infinite;color:var(--pink);}
@keyframes curs{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:0}}
.h-sub{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;max-width:560px;margin:0 0 28px;}
.h-btns{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:32px;justify-content:flex-start;}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:50px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;border:none;outline:none;transition:all .3s;font-family:'DM Sans',-apple-system,sans-serif;}
.btn-g{background:var(--grad);color:#000;}
.btn-g:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--glow-c);}
.btn-o{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid rgba(0,245,255,0.25);color:var(--text);}
.btn-o:hover{border-color:var(--cyan);color:var(--cyan);background:rgba(0,245,255,0.05);transform:translateY(-3px);}
.btn-w{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#25d366,#1ea952);color:#fff;}
.btn-w:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(37,211,102,0.35);}
.h-trust{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-start;}
.h-trust-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);}
.h-trust-item i{color:var(--cyan);font-size:13px;}

/* Hero Image - Full-size premium portrait (no box, transparent bg) */
.h-right{position:relative;flex:0 0 auto;animation:heroSlideRight 1.15s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.3,1) both;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;}
.h-circle{position:relative;width:clamp(240px,32vw,380px);aspect-ratio:1/1;border-radius:50%;padding:6px;background:conic-gradient(from 140deg,var(--cyan),var(--pink),var(--purple),var(--cyan));box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,245,255,.28),0 10px 40px rgba(255,0,180,.18);animation:float-img 6s ease-in-out infinite;}
.h-circle::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-14px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,245,255,.20),rgba(0,245,255,.07) 48%,transparent 74%);z-index:-1;animation:glow-pulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;}
.h-circle-inner{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;background:#0a0f1c;background-image:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');background-size:cover;background-position:center 20%;}
.h-circle-inner img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 20%;display:block;transition:transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.3,1);}
.h-circle:hover .h-circle-inner img{transform:scale(1.05);}
@keyframes glow-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:.55}50%{opacity:1}}
@keyframes float-img{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}
@keyframes heroSlideLeft{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-40px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0)}}
@keyframes heroSlideRight{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(40px) scale(.96)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0) scale(1)}}
.h-chip{position:absolute;background:rgba(14,21,37,0.96);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:7px 13px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:12px;z-index:4;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35);color:var(--text);}
.h-chip i{color:var(--cyan);}
.hc1{top:14%;left:-18px;animation:chip-float 3s ease-in-out infinite;}
.hc2{bottom:14%;right:-18px;animation:chip-float 3.6s ease-in-out infinite .4s;}
@keyframes chip-float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}


@keyframes heroFadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes titleShine{0%{background-position:0% 50%}50%{background-position:100% 50%}100%{background-position:0% 50%}}
@keyframes titleReveal{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.h-title{animation:titleReveal 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.3,1) both;}
.h-title .h-grad{background-size:200% 200%;animation:titleShine 5s ease-in-out infinite;}
.h-title .line{display:inline-block;opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);animation:titleReveal .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.3,1) forwards;}
.h-title .line:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.1s}
.h-title .line:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.35s}
.h-title .line:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.6s}
.h-title .line:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.85s}

/* ===== GENERIC SECTION =====*/
section{padding:56px 5%;}
.sec-label{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cyan);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:10px;}
.sec-title{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,42px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:14px;}
.sec-grad{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
.sec-sub{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);max-width:520px;line-height:1.75;}
.sec-divider{width:52px;height:3px;background:var(--grad);border-radius:2px;margin-top:14px;}
.sec-hd{margin-bottom:52px;}

/* ===== ABOUT ===== */
#about{background:var(--bg2);}
.a-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 0.9fr;gap:56px;align-items:start;}
.a-text{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.a-text b{color:var(--text);font-weight:500;}
.a-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:20px 0 28px;}
.a-tag{padding:5px 13px;background:rgba(0,245,255,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,0.14);border-radius:50px;font-size:12px;color:var(--cyan);}

/* Timeline */
.tl{position:relative;padding-left:22px;}
.tl::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:6px;bottom:6px;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--cyan),var(--violet));}
.tl-item{position:relative;margin-bottom:26px;}
.tl-dot{position:absolute;left:-29px;top:5px;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,245,255,0.6);border:2px solid var(--bg2);}
.tl-yr{font-size:11px;color:var(--cyan);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:3px;letter-spacing:.5px;}
.tl-t{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:3px;}
.tl-d{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);}

/* Skills */
.sk-row{display:grid;gap:13px;}
.sk-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.sk-name{min-width:130px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;}
.sk-bar{flex:1;height:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;}
.sk-fill{height:100%;background:var(--grad);border-radius:3px;width:0;transition:width 1.4s ease;}
.sk-pct{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);min-width:32px;text-align:right;}

/* ===== SERVICES ===== */
#services{background:var(--bg);}
.sv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:22px;}
.sv-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:all .35s;cursor:default;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}.sv-img-wrap{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/10;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--card2),var(--bg3));}.sv-img-wrap img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .6s ease;}.sv-card:hover .sv-img-wrap img{transform:scale(1.08);}.sv-img-wrap::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 40%,rgba(10,10,15,0.85) 100%);}.sv-body{padding:26px 28px 28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;}.sv-body .sv-tag{position:absolute;top:14px;left:14px;z-index:2;}
.sv-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,245,255,0.03),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s;}
.sv-card:hover{transform:translateY(-7px);border-color:rgba(0,245,255,0.28);box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.4),var(--glow-c);}
.sv-card:hover::before{opacity:1;}
.sv-ico{font-size:32px;margin-bottom:16px;display:block;}
.sv-tag{font-size:11px;color:var(--pink);letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px;}
.sv-title{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;}
.sv-desc{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:16px;}
.sv-feats{list-style:none;margin-bottom:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;}
.sv-feats li{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;}
.sv-feats li::before{content:'';width:5px;height:5px;background:var(--cyan);border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;}
.sv-price{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:16px;}
.sv-price span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:400;}
.sv-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:rgba(0,245,255,0.07);border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,0.18);color:var(--cyan);padding:9px 18px;border-radius:50px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,0.2);}
.sv-card:hover .sv-btn{background:var(--grad);color:#000;border-color:transparent;}

/* ===== PROJECTS ===== */
#projects{background:var(--bg2);}
.pf-btns{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:36px;}
.pf-btn{padding:7px 18px;border-radius:50px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;font-family:'DM Sans',-apple-system,sans-serif;}
.pf-btn.on,.pf-btn:hover{background:var(--grad);color:#000;border-color:transparent;font-weight:600;}
.pj-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:20px;}
.pj-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;}
.pj-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 20px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.45),0 0 30px rgba(0,245,255,0.08);}
.pj-num{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:46px;font-weight:800;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;letter-spacing:-2px;}
.pj-thumb{aspect-ratio:16/9;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--card2),var(--bg3));position:relative;overflow:hidden;}.pj-img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .5s ease;}.pj-card:hover .pj-img{transform:scale(1.06);}.pj-num-badge{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.84);color:#fff;font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:50px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);z-index:2;}
.pj-ov{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,245,255,0.12),rgba(124,58,237,0.12));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;}
.pj-card:hover .pj-ov{opacity:1;}
.pj-ov-btn{width:38px;height:38px;background:rgba(0,245,255,0.9);color:#000;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;transform:scale(.7);transition:transform .3s;}
.pj-card:hover .pj-ov-btn{transform:scale(1);}
.pj-body{padding:16px;}
.pj-cat{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:50px;background:rgba(0,245,255,0.08);color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;}
.pj-title{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:5px;}
.pj-desc{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6;}

/* ===== WHY ===== */
#why{background:var(--bg);}
.wy-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:18px;}
.wy-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:26px 20px;text-align:center;transition:all .3s;}
.wy-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:rgba(0,245,255,0.22);box-shadow:var(--glow-c);}
.wy-ico{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(0,245,255,0.07);border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,0.16);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:22px;margin:0 auto 14px;}
.wy-card h3{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:7px;}
.wy-card p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.65;}
.counters-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:52px;padding:36px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;}
.cnt-item{text-align:center;}
.cnt-num{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:40px;font-weight:800;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
.cnt-lbl{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:5px;}

/* ===== REVIEWS ===== */
#reviews{background:var(--bg2);overflow:hidden;}
.rv-outer{overflow:hidden;}
.rv-track{display:flex;gap:22px;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);}
.rv-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;padding:26px;flex:0 0 320px;transition:all .3s;}
.rv-card:hover{border-color:rgba(0,245,255,0.22);}
.rv-stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:12px;letter-spacing:2px;}
.rv-text{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:18px;font-style:italic;}
.rv-author{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.rv-av{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:#000;flex-shrink:0;}
.rv-name{font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;}
.rv-role{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);}
.sl-ctrl{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin-top:26px;}
.sl-btn{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;font-size:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.sl-btn:hover{background:var(--cyan);color:#000;border-color:var(--cyan);}
.sl-dots{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;}
.sl-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--border);cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;}
.sl-dot.on{background:var(--cyan);width:22px;border-radius:3px;}

/* ===== PRICING ===== */
#pricing{background:var(--bg);}
.pr-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(270px,1fr));gap:22px;margin-bottom:44px;}
.pr-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;padding:34px 30px;position:relative;transition:all .3s;}
.pr-card.pop{border:1.5px solid var(--cyan);background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(0,245,255,0.04),rgba(124,58,237,0.04));}
.pr-card:hover{transform:translateY(-7px);}
.pr-card.pop:hover{box-shadow:var(--glow-c);}
.pr-badge{position:absolute;top:-13px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--grad);color:#000;padding:3px 16px;border-radius:50px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;animation:pulse-badge 2s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes pulse-badge{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(0,245,255,.4)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(0,245,255,0)}}
.pr-tier{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:10px;}
.pr-amt{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:46px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:4px;}
.pr-amt sup{font-size:18px;color:var(--cyan);}
.pr-period{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:22px;}
.pr-feats{list-style:none;margin-bottom:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px;}
.pr-feats li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);}
.pr-feats li .chk{color:var(--cyan);font-size:12px;width:14px;}
.pr-feats li .no{color:rgba(136,146,176,.4);font-size:12px;width:14px;}
.pr-btn{display:block;text-align:center;padding:12px;border-radius:50px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;font-family:'DM Sans',-apple-system,sans-serif;}
.pr-btn-out{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);}
.pr-btn-out:hover,.pr-card.pop .pr-btn-out{background:var(--grad);color:#000;border-color:transparent;}
.ao-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:36px;}
.ao-card{background:var(--card2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;transition:all .3s;}
.ao-card:hover{border-color:rgba(0,245,255,.22);transform:translateX(3px);}
.ao-name{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;}
.ao-price{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--cyan);}
.tr-bar{display:flex;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:22px 26px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:24px;}
.tr-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:13.5px;}
.tr-item i{color:var(--cyan);}

/* ===== CONTACT ===== */
#contact{background:var(--bg2);}
.ct-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.2fr;gap:56px;align-items:start;}
.ct-info p{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:26px;}
.ct-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;margin-bottom:18px;}
.ct-ico{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(0,245,255,0.07);border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,0.14);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:17px;flex-shrink:0;}
.ct-lbl{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-bottom:2px;}
.ct-val{font-size:14px;color:var(--text);transition:color .2s;}
.ct-val:hover{color:var(--cyan);}
.soc-row{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:24px;}
.soc-btn{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;transition:all .3s;}
.soc-btn:hover{background:var(--cyan);color:#000;border-color:var(--cyan);transform:translateY(-4px);}
.wa-cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#25d366,#1db954);color:#fff;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:50px;font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;margin-top:18px;transition:all .3s;}
.wa-cta:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(37,211,102,.35);}
.ct-form{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;padding:32px;}
.f-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;}
.f-group{margin-bottom:14px;}
.f-group label{display:block;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:5px;font-weight:500;}
.f-ctrl{width:100%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;padding:11px 15px;color:var(--text);font-size:13.5px;font-family:'DM Sans',-apple-system,sans-serif;outline:none;transition:all .3s;}
.f-ctrl:focus{border-color:var(--cyan);background:rgba(0,245,255,0.03);box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(0,245,255,.1);}
.f-ctrl::placeholder{color:rgba(136,146,176,.45);}
textarea.f-ctrl{resize:none;height:110px;}
.f-submit{width:100%;padding:13px;border-radius:50px;background:var(--grad);color:#000;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',-apple-system,sans-serif;transition:all .3s;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;}
.f-submit:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:var(--glow-c);}
.f-success{display:none;text-align:center;padding:30px 20px;color:var(--cyan);}
.f-success i{font-size:42px;margin-bottom:10px;display:block;}

/* ===== FOOTER ===== */
footer{background:var(--bg3);border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:32px 5% 18px;}
.ft-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr;gap:36px;margin-bottom:36px;}
.ft-logo{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:24px;font-weight:800;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;margin-bottom:10px;}
.ft-desc{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;max-width:240px;}
.ft-h{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.ft-h i{color:var(--cyan);font-size:13px;}
.ft-ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;}
.ft-ul li{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;}
.ft-ul li i{width:14px;color:var(--cyan);font-size:12px;opacity:.85;}
.ft-ul a{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;transition:color .2s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;}
.ft-ul a:hover{color:var(--cyan);}
.ft-ul a:hover i{opacity:1;}
.ft-ul a:hover{color:var(--cyan);}
.ft-bottom{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);}
.ft-bottom span.c{color:var(--cyan);}

/* ===== CHATBOT ===== */
#cb-toggle{position:fixed;bottom:26px;right:26px;width:54px;height:54px;background:var(--grad);color:#000;border:none;border-radius:50%;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;z-index:8000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:var(--glow-c);animation:chip-float 3s ease-in-out infinite;}
#cb-panel{position:fixed;bottom:92px;right:26px;width:310px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;z-index:8000;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 16px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5),var(--glow-c);display:none;}
#cb-panel.open{display:flex;}
.cb-hd{background:var(--grad);padding:14px 16px;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
.cb-hd h4{color:#000;font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;}
.cb-hd button{background:none;border:none;color:#000;font-size:17px;cursor:pointer;opacity:.7;line-height:1;}
.cb-msgs{padding:14px;height:220px;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
.cb-m{max-width:86%;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;}
.cb-m.bot{background:rgba(0,245,255,0.07);border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.13);border-radius:10px 10px 10px 2px;align-self:flex-start;}
.cb-m.usr{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(124,58,237,.3),rgba(0,245,255,.2));border-radius:10px 10px 2px 10px;align-self:flex-end;}
.cb-inp-row{padding:11px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;gap:7px;}
.cb-inp{flex:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;padding:7px 11px;color:var(--text);font-size:13px;font-family:'DM Sans',-apple-system,sans-serif;outline:none;}
.cb-inp:focus{border-color:rgba(0,245,255,.3);}
.cb-send{background:var(--grad);color:#000;border:none;border-radius:7px;width:34px;height:34px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}

/* ===== THEME ===== */
#theme-btn{position:fixed;bottom:92px;right:26px;width:38px;height:38px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text);font-size:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:7999;transition:all .3s;}
#theme-btn:hover{border-color:var(--cyan);background:rgba(0,245,255,.08);}

/* ===== MODAL ===== */
.modal-bg{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.85);z-index:50000;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;}
.modal-bg.open{display:flex;}
.modal-box{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;padding:34px;max-width:480px;width:100%;position:relative;animation:mIn .3s ease;}
@keyframes mIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.92)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
.m-close{position:absolute;top:14px;right:18px;background:none;border:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;transition:color .2s;line-height:1;}
.m-close:hover{color:var(--cyan);}
.m-cat{font-size:11px;color:var(--cyan);letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;}
.m-title{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:10px;}
.m-desc{color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:18px;}
.m-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-bottom:20px;}
.m-tag{padding:4px 11px;background:rgba(0,245,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.15);border-radius:50px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--cyan);}
.m-links{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.m-link{display:inline-block;padding:9px 18px;border-radius:50px;background:var(--grad);color:#000;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;transition:all .3s;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;position:relative;z-index:2;}
.m-link:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:var(--glow-c);}
.m-link.out{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);}
.m-link.out:hover{border-color:var(--cyan);color:var(--cyan);}

/* ===== AOS ===== */
[data-aos]{opacity:0;transition-property:opacity,transform;}
[data-aos].aos-on{opacity:1;}

/* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
@media(max-width:860px){
  .a-grid,.ct-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .ft-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
}
@media(max-width:860px){
  .h-wrap{flex-direction:column;text-align:center;gap:28px;}
  .h-right{order:-1;margin-top:8px;}
  .h-left{order:2;}
  .h-left{text-align:center;max-width:100%;}
  .h-sub{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
  .h-btns,.h-trust{justify-content:center;}
  .h-circle{width:clamp(200px,60vw,300px);}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .n-links{display:none;}
  #n-burger{display:flex;}
  .h-title{font-size:clamp(24px,7.5vw,40px);}
  .h-sub{font-size:14px;}
  #hero{padding:96px 5% 48px;min-height:auto;}
  .hc1,.hc2{display:none;}
  .ft-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .f-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  #cb-panel{width:calc(100vw - 36px);right:18px;}
}
@media(max-width:480px){section{padding:40px 4%;} .h-btns .btn{padding:10px 16px;font-size:13px;}}

/* ===== FADE-IN ANIMATION ===== */
.fade-up{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);transition:opacity .65s ease,transform .65s ease;}
.fade-up.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
.fade-left{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-30px);transition:opacity .65s ease,transform .65s ease;}
.fade-left.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0);}
.fade-right{opacity:0;transform:translateX(30px);transition:opacity .65s ease,transform .65s ease;}
.fade-right.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0);}

/* ======================================================
   CERTIFICATES SECTION — PREMIUM LEVEL
   ====================================================== */
#certificates{
  background:var(--bg);
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}
#certificates::before{
  content:'';
  position:absolute;
  top:-200px;left:50%;
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:800px;height:800px;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(124,58,237,.07) 0%,transparent 70%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.cert-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));
  gap:22px;
  margin-top:8px;
}
/* Staggered delay */
.cert-card:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.05s}
.cert-card:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s}
.cert-card:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.25s}
.cert-card:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.35s}
.cert-card:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.45s}

.cert-card{
  background:var(--card);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:22px;
  overflow:hidden;
  cursor:pointer;
  position:relative;
  transition:transform .42s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),
             box-shadow .42s ease,
             border-color .42s ease;
  opacity:0;
  transform:translateY(40px);
}
.cert-card.c-visible{
  opacity:1;
  transform:translateY(0);
  transition:opacity .65s ease,transform .65s ease,
             box-shadow .42s ease,border-color .42s ease;
}
/* Keep hover separate for visible cards */
.cert-card.c-visible:hover{
  transform:translateY(-12px) scale(1.02);
  box-shadow:0 30px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.55),
             0 0 40px rgba(0,245,255,.14),
             0 0 0 1px rgba(0,245,255,.3);
  border-color:rgba(0,245,255,.4);
}
/* Shine sweep on hover */
.cert-card::after{
  content:'';
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 40%,rgba(255,255,255,.07) 50%,transparent 60%);
  opacity:0;
  transition:opacity .3s;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.cert-card.c-visible:hover::after{opacity:1;}

.cert-img-wrap{
  width:100%;
  aspect-ratio:4/3;
  overflow:hidden;
  position:relative;
  background:#fff;
  padding:8px;
}
.cert-img-wrap img{
  width:100%;height:100%;
  object-fit:contain;
  display:block;
  transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1);
}
.cert-card.c-visible:hover .cert-img-wrap img{transform:scale(1.08);}

/* Demo placeholder */
.cert-demo-thumb{
  width:100%;
  aspect-ratio:3/2;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  gap:10px;
  font-size:60px;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.cert-demo-thumb .cert-demo-label{
  font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:3px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  font-weight:600;
}

/* Overlay on image */
.cert-overlay{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,245,255,.18),rgba(124,58,237,.18));
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  opacity:0;
  transition:opacity .35s;
}
.cert-overlay i{font-size:30px;color:#fff;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.5));}
.cert-card.c-visible:hover .cert-overlay{opacity:1;}

.cert-body{
  padding:16px 20px 20px;
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;
}
.cert-info{flex:1;}
.cert-title{
  font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;
  font-size:14px;font-weight:700;
  color:var(--text);line-height:1.4;
  margin-bottom:4px;
}
.cert-issuer{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);}
.cert-badge{
  flex-shrink:0;
  font-size:10px;padding:3px 10px;
  border-radius:50px;
  background:rgba(0,245,255,.08);
  border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.2);
  color:var(--cyan);white-space:nowrap;
  font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;
  align-self:flex-start;
}

/* Score row */

.cert-desc{padding:0 18px 14px;margin:0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--muted);}
.cert-score{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  padding:8px 20px 16px;
  font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);
}
.cert-score-stars{color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:2px;}
.cert-score-val{font-weight:700;color:var(--cyan);font-size:12.5px;}

/* ── Lightbox ── */
#cert-lb{
  position:fixed;inset:0;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.92);
  z-index:90000;
  display:none;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:20px;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.94);
}
#cert-lb.open{display:flex;}
#cert-lb-inner{
  position:relative;
  max-width:860px;width:100%;
  animation:lbPop .4s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1);
}
@keyframes lbPop{
  from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.84) translateY(24px)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1) translateY(0)}
}
#cert-lb-img{
  width:100%;display:block;
  border-radius:18px;
  box-shadow:0 40px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.85),
             0 0 60px rgba(0,245,255,.15),
             0 0 0 1px rgba(0,245,255,.12);
}
#cert-lb-footer{
  margin-top:14px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;
}
#cert-lb-title{
  font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;
  color:var(--text);
}
#cert-lb-close{
  position:absolute;top:-14px;right:-14px;
  width:40px;height:40px;
  background:var(--grad);border:none;border-radius:50%;
  color:#000;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,245,255,.4);
  transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s;
  z-index:2;
}
#cert-lb-close:hover{transform:rotate(90deg) scale(1.15);box-shadow:0 6px 28px rgba(0,245,255,.6);}
.cert-lb-nav{
  display:flex;gap:8px;
}
.cert-lb-nav button{
  width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
  color:#fff;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:all .25s;
}
.cert-lb-nav button:hover{background:var(--cyan);color:#000;border-color:var(--cyan);}

@media(max-width:640px){
  .cert-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  #cert-lb-inner{max-width:100%;}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  .cert-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
}

</style>

<style id="mf-brand-fix">
/* ===== BRAND LOGO (provided official MF mark) ===== */
.n-logo img,.ft-logo img,.mf-brand-img{
  background:none!important;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;
  object-fit:contain;image-rendering:auto;max-width:100%;height:auto;
  -webkit-user-drag:none;user-select:none;transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.3,1),filter .35s ease;
}
.n-logo img{width:44px;height:44px;}
.n-logo:hover img{transform:scale(1.06) rotate(-2deg);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(0,245,255,.55));}
.ft-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;}
.ft-logo img{height:54px;width:auto;display:block;}
.ft-logo:hover img{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.04);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(0,245,255,.5));}
@media(max-width:900px){.n-logo img{width:38px;height:38px;}.ft-logo img{height:46px;}}
@media(max-width:520px){.n-logo img{width:34px;height:34px;}.ft-logo img{height:42px;}}
</style>

<style id="mf-motion">
/* ================= MF MOTION SYSTEM v2 — cinematic ================= */
:root{
  --mf-ease:cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.28,1);
  --mf-ease-soft:cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.2,1);
  --mf-ease-out:cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1);
  --mf-d-sec:1.05s;   /* section entrance */
  --mf-d-hero:1.35s;  /* hero / major */
  --mf-d-card:.9s;    /* cards */
  --mf-d-foot:1.25s;  /* footer */
  --mf-d-hov:.42s;    /* hover */
  --mf-d-page:.9s;    /* page transition */
  --mf-stag:110ms;    /* stagger step */
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{overflow-x:hidden;}

/* ---------- Scroll reveal: variety of entrances ---------- */
[data-mf-reveal]{
  opacity:0;will-change:opacity,transform;
  transition:opacity var(--mf-d-sec) var(--mf-ease-out),
             transform var(--mf-d-sec) var(--mf-ease-out),
             filter var(--mf-d-sec) var(--mf-ease-soft);
  transition-delay:calc(var(--mf-i,0) * var(--mf-stag));
}
[data-mf-reveal="up"]      {transform:translate3d(0,46px,0);}
[data-mf-reveal="down"]    {transform:translate3d(0,-38px,0);}
[data-mf-reveal="left"]    {transform:translate3d(-56px,0,0);}
[data-mf-reveal="right"]   {transform:translate3d(56px,0,0);}
[data-mf-reveal="scale"]   {transform:scale(.9);}
[data-mf-reveal="zoom"]    {transform:scale(1.06);}
[data-mf-reveal="blur"]    {transform:translate3d(0,28px,0);}  /* legacy key: clean fade+slide, NO blur */
[data-mf-reveal="card"]    {transform:translate3d(0,54px,0) scale(.965);transition-duration:var(--mf-d-card);}
[data-mf-reveal="tilt"]    {transform:perspective(1200px) rotateX(12deg) translate3d(0,52px,0) scale(.97);transform-origin:50% 100%;}
[data-mf-reveal="tiltL"]   {transform:perspective(1200px) rotateY(-14deg) translate3d(-40px,26px,0);transform-origin:0% 50%;}
[data-mf-reveal="tiltR"]   {transform:perspective(1200px) rotateY(14deg) translate3d(40px,26px,0);transform-origin:100% 50%;}
[data-mf-reveal="hero"]    {transform:translate3d(0,60px,0) scale(.965);
                            transition-duration:var(--mf-d-hero);}
[data-mf-reveal="img"]     {transform:scale(1.10);
                            transition-duration:var(--mf-d-hero);}
[data-mf-reveal="btn"]     {transform:translate3d(0,26px,0) scale(.94);transition-duration:.8s;}
[data-mf-reveal].mf-in{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none;}

/* Mask reveal wrapper (images / headings) */
.mf-mask{position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:block;}
.mf-mask::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--bg,#05070c);
  transform:translate3d(0,0,0);transition:transform 1.15s var(--mf-ease-out);z-index:2;pointer-events:none;}
.mf-mask.mf-in::after{transform:translate3d(101%,0,0);}

/* Sequential text reveal (headings split into words) */
.mf-word{display:inline-block;opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,.7em,0) rotateX(28deg);
  transform-origin:50% 100%;
  transition:opacity .95s var(--mf-ease-out),transform .95s var(--mf-ease-out);
  transition-delay:calc(var(--mf-w,0) * 65ms);}
.mf-in .mf-word,.mf-word.mf-in{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none;}

/* ---------- Page / section transitions ---------- */
.mf-page-enter{animation:mfPageIn var(--mf-d-page) var(--mf-ease-out) both;}
@keyframes mfPageIn{
  0%{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,34px,0) scale(.985);}
  100%{opacity:1;transform:none;}
}
#mf-veil{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99998;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,rgba(0,245,255,.06),rgba(0,0,0,.55));
  transition:opacity .42s var(--mf-ease-soft);}
#mf-veil.on{opacity:1;}

/* ---------- Cards: lift, glow, sheen ---------- */
.sv-card,.pj-card,.wy-card,.rv-card,.pr-card,.ao-card,.cert-card,.tl-item,.ct-form{
  position:relative;
  transition:transform var(--mf-d-hov) var(--mf-ease),
             box-shadow var(--mf-d-hov) var(--mf-ease),
             border-color var(--mf-d-hov) var(--mf-ease),
             background var(--mf-d-hov) ease;}
.sv-card::after,.pj-card::after,.rv-card::after,.pr-card::after,.cert-card::after,.wy-card::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;
  background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 35%,rgba(255,255,255,.10) 48%,transparent 62%);
  background-size:250% 100%;background-position:180% 0;opacity:0;
  transition:background-position .95s var(--mf-ease-out),opacity .35s ease;}
.sv-card:hover::after,.pj-card:hover::after,.rv-card:hover::after,
.pr-card:hover::after,.cert-card:hover::after,.wy-card:hover::after{
  opacity:1;background-position:-60% 0;}
.sv-card:hover,.pj-card:hover,.wy-card:hover,.rv-card:hover,.pr-card:hover,.cert-card:hover{
  transform:translateY(-12px) scale(1.014);
  box-shadow:0 26px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 0 34px rgba(0,245,255,.16);}
.ao-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.01);border-color:rgba(0,245,255,.4);}
.tl-item:hover{transform:translateX(6px);}

/* ---------- Images ---------- */
.sv-img-wrap,.pj-img,.cert-thumb{overflow:hidden;}
.sv-img-wrap img,.pj-img img,.cert-card img{
  transition:transform .95s var(--mf-ease-out),filter .8s var(--mf-ease-soft);
  backface-visibility:hidden;}
.sv-card:hover .sv-img-wrap img,.pj-card:hover img,.cert-card:hover img{
  transform:scale(1.09);filter:saturate(1.12) brightness(1.05);}

/* ---------- Buttons ---------- */
.btn,.btn-1,.btn-2,.f-submit,.wa-cta,.pf-btns button,.pr-btn,.sv-btn{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:transform var(--mf-d-hov) var(--mf-ease),box-shadow var(--mf-d-hov) var(--mf-ease),
             background .45s ease,color .35s ease,filter .35s ease;}
.btn::before,.btn-1::before,.btn-2::before,.f-submit::before,.wa-cta::before,.pr-btn::before,.sv-btn::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:-120%;width:60%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.28),transparent);
  transform:skewX(-18deg);transition:left .75s var(--mf-ease-out);}
.btn:hover::before,.btn-1:hover::before,.btn-2:hover::before,.f-submit:hover::before,
.wa-cta:hover::before,.pr-btn:hover::before,.sv-btn:hover::before{left:135%;}
.btn:hover,.btn-1:hover,.btn-2:hover,.f-submit:hover,.wa-cta:hover,.pr-btn:hover,.sv-btn:hover{
  transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1.035);box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(0,245,255,.22);}
.btn:active,.btn-1:active,.btn-2:active,.f-submit:active,.wa-cta:active{transform:translateY(-1px) scale(.975);}

/* ---------- Nav ---------- */
#nav .n-links a{position:relative;transition:color var(--mf-d-hov) var(--mf-ease),transform .35s var(--mf-ease);}
#nav .n-links a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-4px;height:2px;width:0;border-radius:2px;
  background:var(--grad,linear-gradient(90deg,#00f5ff,#9aa7b8));transition:width .45s var(--mf-ease-out);}
#nav .n-links a:hover{color:var(--cyan);transform:translateY(-2px);}
#nav .n-links a:hover::after{width:100%;}
#mobile-nav.active a{animation:mfNavIn .6s var(--mf-ease-out) both;}
@keyframes mfNavIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(-26px,0,0);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}
#mobile-nav.active a:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.04s}
#mobile-nav.active a:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.10s}
#mobile-nav.active a:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.16s}
#mobile-nav.active a:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.22s}
#mobile-nav.active a:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.28s}
#mobile-nav.active a:nth-child(6){animation-delay:.34s}
#mobile-nav.active a:nth-child(7){animation-delay:.40s}
#mobile-nav.active a:nth-child(8){animation-delay:.46s}

/* ================= FOOTER — multi-stage premium reveal ================= */
footer{position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
footer::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-1px;left:-40%;width:45%;height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--cyan,#00f5ff),transparent);
  animation:mfSweep 7s linear infinite;opacity:.65;pointer-events:none;z-index:3;}
@keyframes mfSweep{0%{left:-45%}100%{left:125%}}
footer::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:auto -10% -60% -10%;height:240px;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 100%,rgba(0,245,255,.11),transparent 70%);
  animation:mfGlowPulse 9s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes mfGlowPulse{0%,100%{opacity:.4;transform:translateY(8px)}50%{opacity:.9;transform:translateY(-8px)}}

/* stage 0: whole footer softens in */
footer{opacity:.001;transition:opacity .8s var(--mf-ease-soft);}
footer.mf-in{opacity:1;}
/* stage 1: columns one by one */
footer .ft-grid>div{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,52px,0);
  transition:opacity var(--mf-d-foot) var(--mf-ease-out),
             transform var(--mf-d-foot) var(--mf-ease-out);}
footer.mf-in .ft-grid>div{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none;}
footer.mf-in .ft-grid>div:nth-child(1){transition-delay:.10s}
footer.mf-in .ft-grid>div:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.26s}
footer.mf-in .ft-grid>div:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.42s}
footer.mf-in .ft-grid>div:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.58s}
/* stage 2: links stagger inside each column */
footer .ft-ul li,footer .ft-contact li{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(-18px,10px,0);
  transition:opacity .75s var(--mf-ease-out),transform .75s var(--mf-ease-out),color .35s ease;}
footer.mf-in .ft-ul li,footer.mf-in .ft-contact li{opacity:1;transform:none;
  transition-delay:calc(.5s + var(--mf-i,0) * 80ms);}
/* stage 3: social icons scale in */
footer .soc-btn{opacity:0;transform:scale(.6) translateY(14px);
  transition:opacity .7s var(--mf-ease-out),transform .7s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.4,1),
             background .35s ease,color .35s ease,border-color .35s ease,box-shadow .35s ease;}
footer.mf-in .soc-btn{opacity:1;transform:none;transition-delay:calc(.75s + var(--mf-i,0) * 90ms);}
/* stage 4: bottom bar last */
footer .ft-bottom{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,22px,0);
  transition:opacity .9s var(--mf-ease-out) 1.05s,transform .9s var(--mf-ease-out) 1.05s;}
footer.mf-in .ft-bottom{opacity:1;transform:none;}

/* Footer headings */
.ft-h{position:relative;transition:color .35s var(--mf-ease);}
.ft-h::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-6px;height:2px;width:0;border-radius:2px;
  background:var(--grad,linear-gradient(90deg,#00f5ff,#9aa7b8));transition:width .8s var(--mf-ease-out) .55s;}
footer.mf-in .ft-h::after{width:32px;}
.ft-h:hover::after{width:70px;transition-delay:0s;}
.ft-h i{display:inline-block;transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.4,1);}
.ft-h:hover i{transform:rotate(-12deg) scale(1.2);}

/* Footer links hover */
.ft-ul a{position:relative;display:inline-block;
  transition:color .35s var(--mf-ease),transform .4s var(--mf-ease);}
.ft-ul a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:23px;bottom:-2px;height:1px;width:0;
  background:var(--cyan,#00f5ff);transition:width .5s var(--mf-ease-out);}
.ft-ul a:hover{color:var(--text);transform:translateX(8px);}
.ft-ul a:hover::after{width:calc(100% - 23px);}
.ft-ul a i,.ft-ul li i{display:inline-block;transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.4,1),color .35s ease;}
.ft-ul a:hover i{transform:scale(1.3) translateX(2px);color:var(--cyan);}
.ft-contact li:hover{transform:translateX(6px);color:var(--text);}

/* Social icons hover */
.soc-btn{position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.soc-btn i{display:inline-block;transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.4,1);}
.soc-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-7px) scale(1.12)!important;box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(0,245,255,.3);}
.soc-btn:hover i{transform:scale(1.2) rotate(-10deg);}
.soc-btn:active{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(.96)!important;}

/* Inputs */
.f-ctrl,input,textarea,select{transition:border-color .4s ease,background .4s ease,box-shadow .4s ease,transform .4s var(--mf-ease);}
.f-ctrl:focus{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,245,255,.14);}

/* Contact rows */
.ct-row{transition:transform var(--mf-d-hov) var(--mf-ease);}
.ct-row:hover{transform:translateX(7px);}
.ct-ico{transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.4,1),box-shadow .45s ease,background .45s ease;}
.ct-row:hover .ct-ico{transform:scale(1.14) rotate(-8deg);box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(0,245,255,.3);}

/* Logo protection (Search / nav / footer) — never distort */
.n-logo img,.ft-logo img{object-fit:contain;height:auto;max-width:100%;
  image-rendering:-webkit-optimize-contrast;
  transition:transform .5s var(--mf-ease-out),filter .5s ease;}

/* Chatbot / floating */
#cb-panel{transform-origin:bottom right;}
#cb-panel.mf-open{animation:mfPop .55s cubic-bezier(.34,1.4,.4,1) both;}
@keyframes mfPop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px) scale(.94);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}
#theme-btn{transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.4,1);}
#theme-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(18deg) scale(1.08);}

/* Reduced motion */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.001ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;
    transition-duration:.001ms!important;transition-delay:0s!important;}
  [data-mf-reveal],.mf-word{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;filter:none!important;}
  footer,footer .ft-grid>div,footer .ft-bottom,footer .ft-ul li,footer .ft-contact li,footer .soc-btn{
    opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;filter:none!important;}
  .mf-mask::after{display:none;}
}
</style>
</head>
